nodes.label: MockConfigProvider
nodes.rationale: Prevents tests from triggering setup_config_store() and avoids any real DB connection being opened. Used for config isolation in unit tests.

nodes.label: Integration Tests
nodes.rationale: Marked 'integration' and excluded from standard test run. Require live PostgreSQL and optionally Ollama. Covers end-to-end reconciliation and SIMS service against real database.
